descriptionChirho: A defined geographical area, boundary, or district; typically used in the plural (τὰ ὅρια) to denote the borders or territorial limits of a region. All 12 NT occurrences convey the same spatial-geographic meaning with variation limited to grammatical case (genitive, accusative, dative). Multilingual evidence: spa 'regiones/límites/territorios' (regions/borders/territories), hin 'सीमाओं' (sīmāon, boundaries), arb 'تُخُومِ/حُدودِ' (tukhūm/hudūd, borders/limits), kor '지경/지역' (jigyeong/jiyeok, region/territory), swa 'mipaka' (borders). Used in Matthew 2:16, 4:13, 15:22, 19:1, Mark 5:17, 7:31 and parallels.
